text:
sanjay: Quick triage request — I ran an audit-coverage pass and found gaps across API GW, auth, console, billing, and runtime for customer-facing audit events. Can we map owners and prioritize?

kevin: +1. what are the highest-impact gaps?

sanjay: Top 4: 1) API GW not recording client IP + user_agent in audit events. 2) Auth service not emitting role/grant changes with actor_id consistently. 3) Console lacks billing-plan-change and invoice-download events. 4) Runtime (infer) missing request_id and model_version in audit stream. Also need KMS key-id in any key-access events.

elaine: For auth — we only emit admin actions as `admin_event` but payload is opaque. We should add `actor_id`, `actor_email`, `auth_method` and `outcome`. small change on the schema.

kevin: For api gw, we can plumb X-Forwarded-For into the audit middleware. Quick win: add fields `client_ip` and `user_agent` and version the schema v2.

maria: Console events: we already emit `ui_event` but missing structured `resource_type` and `resource_id` for billing actions. Adds too much downstream parsing pain for customers.

bethany: Billing needs invoice download + subscription change events to be customer-visible. We're getting support tickets. Owner: bethany -> will take backlog ticket.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: new schema PR opened in https://git.redwood.local/r/infrastructure/audit-schemas/pulls/42 by sanjay

sanjay: Proposed minimal schema additions (quick patch):
```json
{"event_version":"2","fields":["event_type","timestamp","actor_id","actor_email","client_ip","user_agent","resource_type","resource_id","action","request_id","model_version","kms_key_id","outcome"]}
```

kevin: That looks fine. For API GW we should also include `ingress_lb` and `route_id` so we can correlate with rate-limiting events.

elaine: Migration plan idea: backward-compatible add-only schema, emit both v1 and v2 for 2 weeks using feature-flag, then flip. We'll also add an event version header `X-Audit-Version`.

sanjay: Triage priority suggestions: Quick wins (2 days): api GW client_ip, auth actor_id, billing events. Medium (1 sprint): console resource_id, runtime request_id/model_version, KMS key-id emission. Long (infra): schema registry + customer-facing event validator + docs.

kevin: Can we list tasks and owners? I can take API GW + ingress plumbing.

elaine: I'll own auth schema changes + regression tests.

maria: I'll pick up console resource metadata and add sample events to the docs.

bethany: I'll file billing event ticket and add customer examples; will coordinate with maria.

sanjay: I'll coordinate runtime + KMS, open the PRs, and schedule a cross-team sync Friday. Who can join Friday 10am PT?

kevin: I can.

elaine: I can.

maria: yes.

bethany: maybe, I'll try.

ops-bot: calendar-bot: meeting created: Audit event gap triage — Fri 10:00 PT — invitees: kevin, elaine, maria, sanjay, bethany

sanjay: Next steps I will: 1) create umbrella backlog Epic in Jira: AE-1010, 2) open 1-line PRs for each quick-win, 3) publish interim schema doc + sample events in docs site. I'll post links when done.

kevin: Thanks. Please add acceptance criteria: example event per service (api-gw, auth, console, billing, runtime) and an automated ingestion test that validates presence of `event_version` and `request_id` where applicable.

sanjay: will do. Draft acceptance criteria: - api-gw event includes client_ip, user_agent, ingress_lb, route_id - auth event contains actor_id, actor_email, auth_method, outcome - console billing actions include resource_type/resource_id and invoice_id for downloads - runtime events include request_id and model_version - kms events include kms_key_id and operation.

maria: can you add a sample `invoice_download` event? I can wire the console to that shape.

sanjay: sample `invoice_download` event (one-liner):
```json
{"event_type":"invoice_download","timestamp":"2026-03-25T17:12:34Z","actor_id":"user_abcd","resource_type":"billing_invoice","resource_id":"inv_202603","action":"download","request_id":"req_9988","outcome":"success"}
```

bethany: perfect — I'll use that.

kevin: Any compliance blockers? PCI/sensitive: ensure invoice payload isn't in the audit event (just id). good.

elaine: Also note: for role_grant events we should not log role secret contents. Only metadata (role_id, grantor_id, scope).

sanjay: Agreed. I'll add that to the schema doc and the privacy checklist.

kevin: timeline: quick-wins by Wed next week, medium in sprint. Sound good?

maria: yes.

bethany: thumbs up :thumbsup:

sanjay: I'll post the Epic AE-1010 and individual tickets by EOD. Closing here but will update thread with links. Thanks all.
